pass_rule: A stage is PASS only after real runtime observation produces non-empty, schema-valid, hash-valid evidence for its current run. Downstream PASS states are invalidated whenever an upstream stage is repaired or fails.
release_rule: Release only after the same production implementation passes build verification, independent stages 01-13, real-device verification, adversarial recovery tests, and final evidence audit.
